# Oddsportal API

> Reverse-engineered internal API. Unofficial — may change without notice.

## Documentation Index
- `SKILL.md` (this file)
- `references/REFERENCE.md` (detailed endpoint docs)

## Authentication
Cookie-based (oddsportalcom_session) — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Dependencies
- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Data Read (11)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve detailed information for a specific event by ID.
- `GET /{id}/` — Retrieve detailed information for a specific event by ID.
- `GET /ajax-all-events/topEvents` — Get a list of top upcoming events across all sports.
- `GET /ajax-getCount/MyBookmarks/` — Check the number of events bookmarked by the user.
- `GET /ajax-hot-matches_/home/0/` — Get a list of hot matches from the homepage.
- `GET /ajax-top-predictions/homepage/` — Fetch top predictions from Oddsportal's homepage.
- `GET /api/v1/banners` — Get banner advertisements to display on a website.
- `GET /community/home/lastPredictions/{lastPredictionTimestamp}/` — Get recent predictions from the community after a timestamp.
- `GET /community/home/topUsers/` — Get a list of top users in the Oddsportal community.
- `GET /myPredictions/{myPredictionId}/{myPredictionId}/` — Retrieve details of a specific user prediction by ID.
- `GET /serve/bookmaker/{bookmakerId}/` — Get information about a specific bookmaker by ID.

### Media (2)
- `GET /{id}/api/image/optimize` — Retrieve optimized images related to a specific event.
- `GET /fs/api/v2/font` — Download font files for rendering Oddsportal content.

### Config (1)
- `GET /cdn/prod/config` — Retrieve configuration settings for Oddsportal.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Oddsportal's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Oddsportal data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.oddsportal.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Oddsportal frontend uses
